title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE ATTRACT POLISH
why: The card was stamped v21.51 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the attract mode and recorder polish of 2026-10-09 (v21.48 to v21.56) and the hire fix (v21.52); the rest are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names the attract polish.
